s-heart-on-pause.story: The title track of A.T.'s neo soul album, Heart On Pause. The whole city freezes in the rain while she keeps her love, her time and her energy for the one who learns how to love her right. Not cold, not lost. Just paused.

[Intro]
(Mmm, ooh)
(Heart on pause... on pause)
(Ooh, ooh)

[Verse 1]
Left my phone face down on the counter
Let it ring till it forgot my name
Somebody always got a reason
Why I should drop it all and come again
I used to pour into anybody
Who held a cup out in the rain
Now I keep a little bit for me
Call it learnin', baby, call it grace

[Pre Chorus]
Not every knock is a door I gotta open
Not every spark deserves my flame
I'm savin' all the soft parts of me
For the one who learns to say my name... right

[Chorus]
So I put my heart on pause
Not 'cause I'm cold, not 'cause I'm lost
I'm just waitin' on the one who knows the cost
Of lovin' me right (lovin' me right)
Heart on pause (ooh)
I won't give my time to the wrong
My energy, my focus, I been holdin' on
Till you find out how to love me (how to love me)
Heart on pause

[Verse 2]
Had a job that took my Sundays
Smiled at me and paid me in "next year"
Had some friends who only called me
When the sky fell and they needed me near
I fought for things that never fought for me
Gave my nights to somebody else's dream
Now I'm learnin' "no" is a whole sentence
And the quiet ain't empty, it's free

[Pre Chorus]
Not every table got a seat with my name on it
Not every "stay" is a place to be
I'm savin' all the best parts of me
For the one who takes his time with me... slow

[Chorus]
So I put my heart on pause
Not 'cause I'm cold, not 'cause I'm lost
I'm just waitin' on the one who knows the cost
Of lovin' me right (lovin' me right)
Heart on pause (ooh)
I won't give my time to the wrong
My energy, my focus, I been holdin' on
Till you find out how to love me (how to love me)
Heart on pause

[Bridge]
And if you're out there takin' your time
Learnin' the shape of a heart like mine
I ain't goin' nowhere, I'm just sittin' still
Keepin' it warm, keepin' it real
Press play when you're ready (ready)
Press play when you're sure (sure)
I'll be right here where you find me
'Cause I know I'm worth waitin' for

[Final Chorus]
So I put my heart on pause
Not 'cause I'm cold, not 'cause I'm lost
I'm just waitin' on the one who knows the cost
Of lovin' me right (lovin' me right)
Heart on pause (ooh, yeah)
I won't give my time to the wrong
My energy, my focus, I been holdin' on
Till you find out how to love me (how to love me, baby)
Heart on pause (heart on pause)

[Outro]
Not broken, baby, just paused
(Mmm, on pause)
Savin' it all for you
(Ooh) press play...

(Mmm, ooh)

Same window, same weather, we just stand in different light

So when you tell me "baby, be careful", I hear "baby, stay inside"
I used to think I had to win you, line by line and word by word

s-use-your-words.story: When the words run out and your hands want to speak instead, A.T. pulls up a chair and talks to you like a friend. Feelings come and go like the tide, so don't make a permanent choice for a temporary reason. Say your piece, walk away if you need to, and let it cool. Love don't seek to hurt. It looks for even ground.
s-use-your-words.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey... come sit with me a minute.
I'm not here to judge you. I just wanna talk.

[Verse 1]
I know that feeling when the words run out
And your chest gets tight and your hands wanna speak instead
I been in rooms where the air got heavy
Where love started sounding like a war in somebody's head
But listen, baby, that fire you're feeling
It's real, but it's passing, it's weather, not the season
Don't sign forever on a feeling that won't last the night
A permanent choice for a temporary reason

[Pre Chorus]
So breathe with me... slow it down
Say what you need to say, then let it settle down

[Chorus]
Use your words, not your hands
Say your piece and walk away if you can
Love don't seek to hurt, it's looking for balance
Use your words, use your words
Don't let one night take what took years to build
Put it down, let it go, let it heal
Love was never meant to leave a bruise
Use your words... I'm begging you

[Verse 2]
'Cause the moment that it turns physical, it's over
Even if you stay, something in that house won't feel safe
One of y'all starts flinching when the other one gets closer
And you can't love somebody through a door you had to brace
I'm not saying hold it in until you're breaking
Take a drive, take a walk, go and call a friend
Tell 'em "I need space," that ain't weakness, that's wisdom
Walking out to cool off don't mean it's the end

[Pre Chorus]
So breathe with me... slow it down
Say what you need to say, then let it settle down

[Chorus]
Use your words, not your hands
Say your piece and walk away if you can
Love don't seek to hurt, it's looking for balance
Use your words, use your words
Don't let one night take what took years to build
Put it down, let it go, let it heal
Love was never meant to leave a bruise
Use your words... I'm begging you

[Bridge]
Feelings come and go like the tide
You'll see it different in the morning light
Love don't keep score with a closed fist
Love looks for even ground... equilibrium
And if you can't find it tonight
Just walk away, and come back when you're right

[Final Chorus]
Use your words, not your hands
Say your piece and walk away if you can
Love don't seek to hurt, it's looking for balance
Use your words, use your words
Don't let one night take what took years to build
Put it down, let it go, let it heal
Love was never meant to leave a bruise
Use your words... I'm begging you

[Outro]
You still with me? Good.
Next time it gets heated... remember this song.
Say your piece. Then walk away.
'Cause love... love seeks peace.
